landmarks.name: Caesars Palace
landmarks.fact: Caesars Palace is a famous Roman-themed luxury hotel and casino on the Las Vegas Strip.

landmarks.name: Casino Royale
landmarks.fact: Casino Royale is a low-rise hotel and casino located on the Las Vegas Strip.

landmarks.name: The Venetian Las Vegas
landmarks.fact: The Venetian is an Italian-themed luxury resort featuring replicas of Venice landmarks and indoor canals.

landmarks.name: The Palazzo
landmarks.fact: The Palazzo is a luxury hotel and casino resort that forms part of the larger Venetian complex.

landmarks.name: Wynn Las Vegas
landmarks.fact: Wynn Las Vegas is a premier luxury resort tower known for its distinctive curved bronze-glass facade.

landmarks.name: Fashion Show Mall
landmarks.fact: Fashion Show is a massive shopping destination on the Strip recognized by its futuristic suspended steel structure.

landmarks.name: Encore Las Vegas
landmarks.fact: Encore is the sister resort tower to Wynn Las Vegas, offering high-end suites and nightlife.

landmarks.name: Treasure Island Hotel & Casino
landmarks.fact: Treasure Island is a classic resort hotel on the Strip, originally known for its pirate theme.

landmarks.name: The LINQ Hotel & Casino
landmarks.fact: The LINQ is a vibrant resort situated at the center of the Las Vegas Strip.

landmarks.name: The Cromwell
landmarks.fact: The Cromwell is a boutique hotel and casino known for its vintage Parisian-inspired style.

landmarks.name: Paris Las Vegas
landmarks.fact: Paris Las Vegas is a famous resort featuring a half-scale replica of the Eiffel Tower.

landmarks.name: The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas
landmarks.fact: The Cosmopolitan is a modern luxury resort and casino featuring two iconic high-rise towers.

landmarks.name: ARIA Resort & Casino
landmarks.fact: ARIA is a contemporary resort located within the CityCenter complex on the Las Vegas Strip.

landmarks.name: The Shops at Crystals
landmarks.fact: The Shops at Crystals is an upscale luxury shopping mall known for its striking crystalline architectural design.

landmarks.name: New York-New York Hotel & Casino
landmarks.fact: New York-New York features iconic replicas of Big Apple landmarks, including the Brooklyn Bridge and Statue of Liberty.

landmarks.name: Excalibur Hotel & Casino
landmarks.fact: Excalibur is a castle-themed resort and casino inspired by King Arthur and medieval legends.

landmarks.name: Luxor Hotel & Casino
landmarks.fact: Luxor is an Egyptian-themed hotel famous for its massive black glass pyramid and Great Sphinx replica.
